PIL autocontrast; aspect-preserving LANCZOS enlargement to the recorded widths, height=round(original_crop_height*output_width/original_crop_width); UnsharpMask radius 1.1, percent 120, threshold 3. actual_calculation_scope: Image metadata dimensions were read. Half-b offset was obtained by the finite height subtraction 2363-1262=1101.
